rationale: On page 1 the advisory states the end-user, JSC Avangard, is 'blocked by operation of law and majority owned by designated JSC Concern Almaz Antey' -- a direct instance of SAN001's determinative indicator, 'a control path reaching a designated party at >=50%'. Unlike SAN001's doctrine framing of deliberate concealment via layered structures, this case is OFAC finding that the exporter failed to identify an openly-stated 50%-rule-blocked entity; there is no concealment alleged, so confidence is medium rather than high.

citations.quote: a Russian defense manufacturer that is blocked by operation of law and majority owned by designated JSC Concern Almaz Antey
